changes.text: 另一层容易被忽略的是钱粮。西征之初，左宗棠请借外债，诏拨款五百万、敕自借外国债五百万；史书说，出塞凡二十月，新疆南北城尽复，是馈运饶给之力。作者推断，「堅忍而求勝」一句背后是运道与饷项，没有这些，战阵那一步只是姿态。

The layer easily missed is money and grain. At the outset of the western expedition, Zuo asked to borrow from abroad; the court allotted five million and directed him to raise a further five million as a foreign loan. The history says that in twenty months beyond the passes, the cities of northern and southern Xinjiang were all recovered — and that it was the abundance of supply transport that accomplished it. The author's inference: behind those words about being "patient and set on victory" lay supply routes and payrolls. Without them, the second step was only a posture.

dispositions.rationale: 中文把五字引文「堅忍而求勝」误称为“四个字”。已删去字数说法，改为「堅忍而求勝」一句背后，不再计数。英文原本作 those words，没有计数错误，内容保持不变，按中英同步规则一并给出全文。

evidence.quote: 次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝
